title: perf.optimize
description: Optimize for this PC: measure the settings that set its speed (tools/bench/tune_machine.py, in a child process) and propose values, without changing anything. Evidence from past runs shortens it: plan lists every stage with run (false: skipped), narrow (only values next to the ones in use) and why (code): optimize.steady_evidence (past runs at the settings in use are steady), optimize.no_evidence, optimize.memory_capped (memory has been capping the render, so its full spread is measured), optimize.encode_settled (an earlier optimization measured the same encoder), optimize.not_used_by_runs (scan tunes the bench tool only), optimize.always (inventory), optimize.full (full: true). stages limits it to some stages (a nudge's action). video is the file to measure on (default: the source with the most pixels per frame). Refused while a job holds the queue (perf.busy), while another optimization runs (perf.optimize_running), and when the machine is busy (perf.machine_busy) unless force: true. While it runs, job.submit answers perf.optimize_running. Progress and the proposal come as perf.optimize_progress events; perf.optimize_apply writes the proposal.
